open_questions.title: ABCD block semantic meaning
open_questions.description: The 'ABCD' block appears in several templates (1R10-PRADM_v2, 1R20-PRADM_*_v2, etc.) above or alongside the DATE: YYWW element. It is unclear whether ABCD is: (a) a product model/variant code, (b) a colour code, (c) a placeholder for a separate print run identifier, or (d) part of the date block itself. It always co-occurs with the date strip.
open_questions.current_assumption: Treated as product_identity / variable alpha code
open_questions.resolution_needed: Confirm data source and allowed values for ABCD field

open_questions.title: Legal symbol cell count and content
open_questions.description: In v4 and v5 variants, a column of legal symbols is shown rotated 90° CW. The individual symbol IDs (e.g., CE mark, WEEE, FSC, etc.) are not legible at the PDF resolution available. The number of cells appears to be 5-6 but is not certain.

evidence.snippet: Legal symbol cells rotated in row 4

open_questions.current_assumption: Modelled as symbol_block with repeatable=true; specific symbols unknown
open_questions.resolution_needed: Higher-resolution PDF or original artwork files needed to identify each symbol

open_questions.title: DATE: prefix visibility in v3 vs raw YYWW
open_questions.description: In 1R10-PRADM_v3 and equivalent 1R20 v3-equivalent rows, the date section appears to show only the YYWW value without an explicit 'DATE:' label prefix. The family rules specify behaviour when 'DATE is available', implying the label 'DATE:' may be conditional. It is unclear whether v3 shows 'DATE: YYWW' or just 'YYWW'.
open_questions.current_assumption: Modelled as YYWW only without DATE: prefix
open_questions.resolution_needed: Confirm whether DATE: prefix is present in v3 or only when date section is expanded

open_questions.title: Colour dot type and placement
open_questions.description: In 1R20-PRADM v3 variants, a small circular element appears to the left of the IKEA logo area. It may be: (a) a colour swatch dot, (b) a rating/quality dot, or (c) a layout marker. It is always filled/solid in the PDF but colour is unknown.

evidence.snippet: Small circle element on label left in row 3

open_questions.current_assumption: Modelled as colour_dot image element, optional, variable content
open_questions.resolution_needed: Confirm purpose, allowed colours, and whether it is mandatory for any product category

open_questions.title: 1234 numeric suffix after YYWW — independent field or part of date?
open_questions.description: A 4-digit numeric value '1234' appears below the YYWW value in v2-type variants. It is unclear whether this is: (a) a separate production batch number, (b) a sequential copy/run number, (c) part of the date encoding, or (d) a patent number suffix.
open_questions.resolution_needed: Confirm data source and format constraints for 1234 field

open_questions.title: Copy count placement within far-right strip in v4/v5
open_questions.description: In v4/v5 variants the far-right strip contains ABCD-YYWW-1234 and in v5 also the copy count. The vertical ordering (which is on top) within the strip is not clear from the PDF.
open_questions.current_assumption: Copy count assumed to be adjacent to ABCD-YYWW strip
open_questions.resolution_needed: Confirm stacking order within far-right strip
